text_sanskrit: उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन । नरके नियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम ॥ १-४४॥
itrans: utsannakuladharmANAM manuShyANA.n janArdana . narake niyata.n vAso bhavatItyanushushruma .. 1-44..
translation: (What are the evils?) In the destruction of the race, the virtues of the race handed down from time immemorial perish altogether. When virtue is lost, vice invades the race. Being overpowered with vice the women of the race become corrupt; women corrupted, O Varshneya, 'the confusion of the Varnas (castes) arises; (such) confusion of castes leads to heil the race as well as those who prove its ruin; for their ancestors fall deprived of rice-balls and libations of water. By these misdeeds of the slayers of family leading to the confusion of castes, the eternal caste virtues of the race are destroyed, 0 Janardana, and men who have lost the virtues of the family, we are told, surely live forever in hell.
